idealSoil: Well-drained Loam with high organic matter
hubs: Andhra Pradesh, Madhya Pradesh, Karnataka, Gujarat, Odisha, Maharashtra
descriptionEn: Major commercial vegetable grown across multiple seasons with high fresh consumption and processing demand.
imageAlt: Ripe red juicy tomatoes hanging from green tomato vines
spacing: 75 cm x 45 cm (or 90 cm x 60 cm for indeterminate)
harvestingIndicator: Fruits develop pink to breaker stage for distant transit, or firm red for local markets.
introTipEn: Staking with bamboo trellises keeps foliage off moist soil; apply Calcium Nitrate during fruit setting to prevent blossom end rot.
efficiencyGain: 35% higher marketable grade fruit with trellis & drip
micronutrientNote: Spray Calcium Nitrate (2 g/L) and Boron (1 g/L) at peak flowering to avoid fruit cracking and blossom end rot.
stagnationAlert: Waterlogging causes rapid bacterial wilt and root asphyxiation; plant on raised beds.

fertilizerStages.fertilizerEn: DAP + Muriate of Potash + Farmyard Manure
fertilizerStages.quantityPerAcre: DAP 45 kg + MOP 35 kg + FYM 8 tonnes / acre
fertilizerStages.applicationMethod: Incorporate thoroughly into raised bed soil before planting
Side-dress along drip lines followed by earthing up
Bi-weekly foliar spray during active harvesting

irrigation.criticalStagesEn: Transplanting recovery, Flowering, and Fruit Development
irrigation.tipsEn: Maintain steady uniform soil moisture to avoid fruit splitting and cracking.

pestsDiseases.symptomsEn: Larvae bore circular entry holes into green and ripe fruits, causing internal decay.
pestsDiseases.controlEn: Spray Chlorantraniliprole 18.5% SC (60 ml/acre) or Flubendiamide (50 ml/acre).

pestsDiseases.symptomsEn: Upward curling, puckering, and severe stunting of plants with reduced fruit set.
pestsDiseases.controlEn: Control whitefly vector with Diafenthiuron 50 WP (250 g/acre) or Cyantraniliprole (1.8 ml/L).

pestsDiseases.symptomsEn: Target-board concentric brown rings on leaves and stem cankers.
pestsDiseases.controlEn: Spray Mancozeb 75 WP (2.5 g/L) or Azoxystrobin + Difenoconazole (1 ml/L).

harvestSteps.textEn: Pick at breaker/turning stage (pink blossom end) for distant transit, or firm red for local consumption.
Harvest by twisting fruits gently with calyx intact during cool morning hours.
Sort by size and color into plastic crates (avoid bamboo basket pressure bruising).
Perform pickings every 3–4 days across a 6–8 week window. Expected yield: 120–180 Qtl/acre.
